Joel Embiid scored a season-high 37 points in the Sixers’ 135-123 road victory over the Brooklyn Nets on Monday, the second half of a back-to-back.
Embiid, who buried a dagger 3-pointer in the final minute after Brooklyn trimmed a 24-point deficit to four, scored 24 of his 37 points in the first half.
The Magic are coming off a 115-105 road win over the Boston Celtics despite Boston making 20 3-pointers.
Orlando’s Desmond Bane scored 15 of his game-high-tying 24 points in the fourth quarter.
Franz Wagner, who recorded 21 points, eight rebounds and nine assists Monday, saw his streak of four consecutive 30-point games come to an end.
